candidate.launch_c3_definition: Squared Sun-centered departure velocity relative to launch body; km^2/s^2
candidate.mismatch_screening_note: Modeled burns plus unresolved excess-speed mismatch sum is a screening criterion, not an actual periapsis burn estimate. Construct powered flybys for physical burn vectors and costs.
candidate.maneuver_budget_note: Explicit designed DSM, target-turnaround impulses and full powered-periapsis vector burns only; unresolved flybys require physical retargeting or a powered-flyby construction, not a scalar mismatch sum.
